Zorko Group · Food-business consultancy

Food-business consultancy.
From questions to a clearer plan.

Planning a food brand, café concept or the next step for an existing business? Start with your goals and the decisions you need help making.

What can you discuss with Zorko consultancy?

Zorko’s published consultancy service describes support around food concepts, menu planning, brand development, marketing strategy and operational guidance. Discuss your specific project with the team to establish which services are appropriate.

A useful first conversation connects the concept, target customers, premises and operating model. Confirm the actual scope, deliverables, fees and implementation responsibilities before work begins.

Prepare a food-business project brief

  1. Describe the stage. Are you exploring an idea, opening a first outlet, improving an existing operation or considering expansion?
  2. Identify the decisions. Explain the questions about concept, menu, customer, brand or operations you need to resolve.
  3. Bring the evidence. Share existing plans, location options, costs and operating information where available.
  4. Agree on the work. Request written deliverables, review points, responsibilities and exclusions.

Franchise expansion and business growth questions

If you are considering franchise expansion, discuss the consistency of your operating processes, training, supply coordination and support model. Ask the consultancy team which parts of the project it can support and what work remains with your own team.

The right brief is more useful than a broad request for the “best consultancy”. Compare relevant experience and proposed deliverables against your actual business need.

Investment, eligibility, availability and commercial terms are confirmed by the relevant team in a current written proposal.

Questions, answered.

Is consultancy the same as buying a franchise?

No. A consultancy engagement concerns an agreed project or business question. A franchise involves a particular brand and operating arrangement. Ask which route matches your goals.

What should I prepare before contacting the team?

Bring a short description of your concept or existing operation, intended customers, location options, budget assumptions and the main decisions you need help with.

Are fees and timelines fixed on this website?

No. Confirm scope, project timing, fees and responsibilities directly with the team.
